maintainer_summary: Adds dark-mode toggle to settings page. Logic is sound; missing persistence and one a11y issue. ~10 min human review once fixed.
strengths: Followed the existing ThemeContext pattern instead of inventing a new one
Clear PR description that links the issue and includes a screenshot

coaching.what: The theme resets to light every time the page reloads.
coaching.why: Issue #388 asks for the choice to be remembered, and the app already stores other preferences in usePreferences().
coaching.question: Where does the app keep the user's language setting between visits, and could the theme live in the same place?

coaching.what: The toggle is a clickable div, so keyboard and screen-reader users can't use it.
coaching.why: The project's CONTRIBUTING.md requires all controls to be keyboard accessible.
coaching.question: Which HTML element gives you focus and keyboard activation for free?

understanding_check: Why did you read the initial theme from context instead of from the toggle's own state?
What happens if a user's OS is set to dark mode but they never touch your toggle?
